title: Kevin Stefanski "very, very pleased" with where Michael Penix is in ACL recovery

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kevin Stefanski "very, very pleased" with where Michael Penix is in ACL recovery
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix has still not been fully cleared to return from his November ACL tear, but the team thinks Penix is exactly where he needs to be at this point in his recovery.
